blocks.html: Where the wild is waiting: climb Kilimanjaro, come face to face with wild chimpanzees and lose yourself in nature. Every trip we offer is an immersive safari, made to measure and full of discovery and adventure. Do you feel ready to step beyond the ordinary?

blocks.orig: Our adventure trips in Tanzania are made for travelers who seek thrill, freedom, and unforgettable moments in the wild. Whether you’re trekking to the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro, tracking chimpanzees through ancient rainforests, or sleeping under canvas in the heart of the Serengeti, every experience is built around your sense of adventure.
blocks.html: We created our adventure trips in Tanzania for travellers who are after excitement, freedom and moments in the wild they will never forget. Maybe you’re hiking up to the top of Mount Kilimanjaro, following chimpanzees through age-old rainforest or spending the night under canvas deep in the Serengeti; whichever it is, each experience is shaped around your appetite for adventure.

blocks.orig: This is more than a safari. It’s a journey crafted for active, curious explorers who want to connect deeply with nature, challenge themselves, and embrace the unexpected. With tailor-made itineraries, expert local guides, and handpicked adventure lodges, we help you experience Tanzania in its rawest, most exhilarating form – from the savannah to the sea. And the best part? It’s all designed around you.
blocks.html: Think of it as more than a safari. It is a journey designed for active, inquisitive explorers who want a close bond with nature, who like to push themselves and who welcome the unexpected. Through tailor-made itineraries, experienced local guides and carefully chosen adventure lodges, we let you feel Tanzania at its most raw and exhilarating – from the savannah all the way to the sea. Best of all, everything is planned around you.

blocks.orig: The Ultimate Wildlife Adventure: Spot the Big Five
blocks.html: The ultimate wildlife adventure: finding the Big Five

blocks.orig: Tracking the Big Five: lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and rhino is one of the most thrilling aspects of an adventure trip in Tanzania. But this isn’t a passive game-viewing experience. It’s an exhilarating journey through some of Africa’s most iconic landscapes, where every rustle in the grass could be your next unforgettable encounter.
blocks.html: One of the most exciting parts of an adventure trip in Tanzania is searching for the Big Five: lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and rhino. Don't expect to sit back and simply watch, though. It is a thrilling journey across some of the best-known landscapes in Africa, where any movement in the grass might turn into an encounter you will never forget.

blocks.orig: Whether you’re bouncing through the Serengeti in an open-roof 4×4, exploring on foot with a ranger in Ngorongoro, or scanning the horizon at sunrise in Ruaha, the chase is part of the magic. This is wildlife viewing at its most raw, immersive, and exciting. And it’s all part of the adventure.
blocks.html: Perhaps you are rattling across the Serengeti in a 4×4 with an open roof, walking with a ranger in Ngorongoro or searching the horizon at dawn in Ruaha: the search itself is part of the magic. Wildlife viewing does not get more raw, immersive or exciting than this, and every moment belongs to the adventure.

blocks.orig: After a thrilling safari or a challenging trek, the perfect way to wind down is with an adventure of a different kind: the island paradise of Zanzibar. From snorkeling and diving in turquoise waters to kite surfing off the eastern coast, Zanzibar offers endless options for active travelers — along with world-class relaxation.
blocks.html: Once your exciting safari or tough trek is over, an adventure of another sort is the ideal way to unwind: the island paradise of Zanzibar. With everything from snorkelling and diving in turquoise water to kitesurfing along the east coast, Zanzibar gives active travellers plenty of choice, as well as excellent opportunities to relax.

blocks.orig: Explore Stone Town’s spice markets, sail into the sunset on a traditional dhow, or simply soak up the sun on powdery beaches after your safari. It’s the ideal blend of tropical discovery and barefoot luxury. And the perfect reward after your adventure trip.
blocks.html: Wander through the spice markets of Stone Town, sail into the sunset aboard a traditional dhow or just enjoy the sun on soft, powdery beaches once your safari is done. It combines tropical discovery with barefoot luxury perfectly. A fitting reward after your adventure trip.
